announcements.title: FIKD Foundation Launches New Qurʾān Programme
announcements.author: Academic Team
announcements.excerpt: We are excited to announce the launch of our enhanced Qurʾān programme, featuring advanced tajwīd, Tafsīr, and a dedicated Ijāzah pathway for students seeking mastery in Qurʾānic recitation.

announcements.title: New Term Enrolment Now Open
announcements.author: Admissions Team
announcements.excerpt: Enrolment for the upcoming term is now open. Secure your place in our Qāʿidah, Qurʾān, and curriculum programmes. Early bird discounts available for a limited time.

announcements.title: Annual Iftar Gathering 2026
announcements.author: Community Team
announcements.excerpt: Join us for our annual Iftar gathering during Ramaḍān. An evening of community, reflection, and spiritual connection. All students, families, and alumni are welcome.

announcements.title: Student Completes Full Qurʾān Memorisation
announcements.author: Academic Team
announcements.excerpt: Congratulations to our student Ahmed Hassan who completed the memorisation of the entire Qurʾān with the support of our dedicated teachers. A remarkable achievement!

announcements.title: Community Outreach Programme Launched
announcements.author: Outreach Team
announcements.excerpt: FIKD Foundation launches a new community outreach initiative to provide Islamic education to underserved communities. Our goal is to make Islamic knowledge accessible to all.

announcements.title: New Teachers Join FIKD Faculty
announcements.author: Admin Team
announcements.excerpt: We are pleased to welcome three new qualified teachers to our faculty, expanding our capacity to serve more students. Meet our new team members!

announcements.title: Ramadan Qurʾān Challenge
announcements.author: Academic Team
announcements.excerpt: Join our Ramadan Qurʾān Challenge! Set a personal goal for Qurʾān recitation or memorisation during the blessed month and earn rewards for your progress.

announcements.title: Student Spotlight: Aisha's Journey
announcements.author: Academic Team
announcements.excerpt: Read about Aisha's inspiring journey from beginner to advanced Qurʾān student, and how FIKD supported her every step of the way. A story of dedication and growth.
